description: This file defines the UploadedFileFactoryInterface, an interface specifying a factory method for creating uploaded file objects in the PSR HTTP Message standard.

classes.name: UploadedFileFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for a factory that creates uploaded file instances, defining a single method for creation with specified parameters.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates a new uploaded file object with specified properties, including stream, size, error code, filename, and media type.
